```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| warning: false

import yaml
import pandas as pd
from html import escape
from IPython.display import display, HTML

# Read the same content used by the homepage.
with open("content/news.yml", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    news_data = yaml.safe_load(f) or {}

items = news_data.get("news", [])

df = pd.DataFrame(items)

if not df.empty:
    df["date"] = pd.to_datetime(df["date"], errors="coerce")
    df = df[df["date"].notna()].copy()
    df = df.sort_values("date", ascending=False)
    df["year"] = df["date"].dt.year.astype(int)

def safe(value):
    return escape(str(value if value is not None else ""), quote=True)

years = (
    sorted(df["year"].unique().tolist(), reverse=True)
    if not df.empty else []
)

year_options = "".join(
    f'<option value="{year}">{year}</option>'
    for year in years
)

total = len(df)

html = f"""
<div class="cw-news-archive">

  <section class="cw-news-archive-hero">
    <div class="cw-news-archive-hero-content">
      <span class="cw-news-archive-eyebrow">
        COASTWATCH WEST COAST NODE
      </span>

      <h1>News Archive</h1>

      <p>
        Explore CoastWatch updates, scientific publications,
        dataset releases, job opportunities, and events.
        Browse past announcements or search for a topic of interest.
      </p>

    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="cw-news-archive-directory">

    <div class="cw-news-archive-section-head">
      <span class="cw-news-archive-label">
        EXPLORE THE ARCHIVE
      </span>
      <h2>Browse News &amp; Events</h2>
      <p>
        Search by keyword or select a year to narrow
        the archive. All announcements are included,
        including those no longer displayed on the homepage.
      </p>
    </div>

    <div class="cw-news-archive-toolbar">

      <div class="cw-news-archive-search">
        <label for="archiveSearch">Search announcements</label>
        <input
          id="archiveSearch"
          type="search"
          placeholder="Search titles, descriptions, or topics..."
        >
      </div>

      <div class="cw-news-archive-filter">
        <label for="archiveYear">Year</label>
        <select id="archiveYear">
          <option value="All">All years</option>
          {year_options}
        </select>
      </div>

      <button
        id="archiveReset"
        class="cw-news-archive-reset"
        type="button"
      >
        Reset filters
      </button>

    </div>

    <div class="cw-news-archive-results">
      <span id="archiveCount">
        Showing {total} of {total} announcements
      </span>
    </div>

    <div id="archiveGroups">
"""

if not df.empty:
    for year, group in df.groupby("year", sort=False):
        html += f"""
        <section class="cw-news-archive-year-group"
                 data-year="{year}">

          <div class="cw-news-archive-year-heading">
            <h2>{year}</h2>
            <span class="cw-news-archive-year-count">
              {len(group)} announcements
            </span>
          </div>

          <div class="cw-news-archive-grid">
        """

        for _, row in group.iterrows():
            title = safe(row.get("title", ""))
            description = str(row.get("description") or "")
            date_label = row["date"].strftime("%B %d, %Y")
            date_iso = row["date"].strftime("%Y-%m-%d")

            # Descriptions are trusted, CMS-maintained content.
            # Preserve embedded links and formatting.
            html += f"""
            <article class="cw-news-archive-card"
                     data-year="{year}">

              <div class="cw-news-archive-card-body">

                <div class="cw-news-archive-card-meta">
                  <time datetime="{date_iso}">
                    {date_label}
                  </time>
                </div>

                <h3>{title}</h3>

                <div class="cw-news-archive-description">
                  {description}
                </div>

              </div>
            </article>
            """

        html += """
          </div>
        </section>
        """

html += """
    </div>

    <div id="archiveEmpty"
         class="cw-news-archive-empty"
         hidden>
      <h3>No matching announcements</h3>
      <p>
        Try another keyword or select a different year.
      </p>
    </div>

  </section>

</div>
"""

display(HTML(html))
```

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {

  const search = document.getElementById("archiveSearch");
  const year = document.getElementById("archiveYear");
  const reset = document.getElementById("archiveReset");
  const cards = Array.from(
    document.querySelectorAll(".cw-news-archive-card")
  );
  const groups = Array.from(
    document.querySelectorAll(".cw-news-archive-year-group")
  );
  const count = document.getElementById("archiveCount");
  const empty = document.getElementById("archiveEmpty");

  if (!search || !year || !reset || !count || !empty) return;

  function filterArchive() {
    const query = search.value.trim().toLowerCase();
    const selectedYear = year.value;

    let visible = 0;

    cards.forEach(card => {
      const matchesSearch =
        card.textContent.toLowerCase().includes(query);

      const matchesYear =
        selectedYear === "All" ||
        card.dataset.year === selectedYear;

      const show = matchesSearch && matchesYear;

      card.hidden = !show;

      if (show) visible++;
    });

    groups.forEach(group => {
      const visibleCards = group.querySelectorAll(
        ".cw-news-archive-card:not([hidden])"
      );

      group.hidden = visibleCards.length === 0;

      const groupCount = group.querySelector(
        ".cw-news-archive-year-count"
      );

      if (groupCount) {
        groupCount.textContent =
          `${visibleCards.length} announcements`;
      }
    });

    count.textContent =
      `Showing ${visible} of ${cards.length} announcements`;

    empty.hidden = visible !== 0;
  }

  search.addEventListener("input", filterArchive);
  year.addEventListener("change", filterArchive);

  reset.addEventListener("click", () => {
    search.value = "";
    year.value = "All";
    filterArchive();
  });

  filterArchive();

});
</script>
